acceptance_criteria: AC-1 The navigation drawer reproduces M3Components.dc.html: the same destinations, in the same order, with the same collapsed and expanded behaviour.
AC-2 Each of Overview, Inventory, Configuration, Compliance, Operations and Administration exists as a routed screen whose layout, type scale, spacing and colour roles follow its M3 frame.
AC-3 The Material 3 token set in ui2/frontend/src/theme/m3Theme.ts carries the exact colour role values used by the frames; no component hard-codes a colour that a token already names.
AC-4 With an empty database every product screen renders its own empty state, and the populated look is reachable only under the existing labelled preview route.
AC-5 The existing test asserting preview data never reaches a product screen still passes, unchanged in intent, and covers every screen added here.
AC-6 No address-shaped literal is added to ui2/frontend/src/preview/previewData.ts or to any other frontend source; the repository privacy gate result is unchanged from the base commit.
AC-7 The frontend build and test suite pass in the foreground and their real output is reported.

baseline.authority: docs/design/PO_DECISION_RECORD_2026_09_12.md (FROZEN) section 4: stand the roof up first -- the shell, its menus and screens -- before the rooms underneath. The design frames in docs/design/ui2_mockups/ are the Product Owner's own canvas and are the visual target.
baseline.sequencing: Runs before device add is wired to a screen. No backend change, no collection.

context_not_loaded: ui2/ Java sources beyond the API shapes the screens call
invariants: Preview data never reaches a product screen; that boundary is test-enforced and must stay.
No address-shaped literal, device name or serial in frontend source -- they reached three built bundles once before.
No vendor data collection, no device contact: the standing collection gate holds.
New feature code is written from scratch; the repository's Python scripts are know-how only, never ported, wrapped or invoked.
The design frames are read-only input.
report.merge_gate: Product Owner assistant review of the diff against the frames plus orchestrator verify.passed. The worker does not open a pull request and does not merge.
report.objective: Rebuild the React shell so every screen and the navigation drawer match the Product Owner's Material 3 design frames in docs/design/ui2_mockups/ (M3Overview, M3Inventory, M3Configuration, M3Compliance, M3Operations, M3Administration, M3Components), with the six product screens present in the navigation and the populated look reachable only through the existing labelled preview route.
output_contract: The six product screens and the navigation drawer matching the M3 frames
Theme tokens carrying the frames' colour roles
SESSION_CLOSE with exact changed files, real test output, and any frame detail deliberately not reproduced with its reason

recommended_reasoning.reason: Bounded UI work against a fixed visual reference; the care is in fidelity and in not leaking preview data, not in novel design.

requirements: English, per AGENTS.md engineering-output language law
Read the seven M3 frames in docs/design/ui2_mockups/ before writing any component
Where a frame shows data the product cannot yet produce, render the empty state, never an invented value on a product screen
Do not open a pull request and do not merge; commit on the lane and publish SESSION_CLOSE
Run the validation plan in the foreground and wait for real results before SESSION_CLOSE
risks: Approximating the frames instead of matching them, which is exactly what this movement exists to correct
Letting synthetic data leak onto a product screen
Reintroducing address-shaped literals into a built bundle
Drifting the theme tokens away from the frames' own values

out: Any Java module under ui2/ other than reading its API shape
Any vendor data collection or device contact

validation_plan: frontend build: npm --prefix ui2/frontend run build
